answer_1.quote: The Natural Language Processing (NLP) domain has recently seen the growing adoption of the question generation (QG) task ...

answer_2.quote: We compare QG-SMS with three individual-scoring metrics: The reference-based BERTScore measures the semantic similarity ... the reference-free KDA evaluates question quality ... the LLM-based QSalience measures the importance of the candidate question ...

answer_3.quote: For all LLM-based experiments with GPT-4o, we used the gpt-4o-2024-05-13 checkpoint ... Vanilla: The LLM is then asked to choose between Q1 and Q2 based on which question better satisfies R_d ... Chain-of-Thoughts, Swap, ChatEval are also employed as pairwise evaluation methods.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three volunteer annotators, including two graduate and one undergraduate student... Annotators are tasked to make preferences on 120 pairs of questions... We provide more details on the question generation process and instructions given to annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given definitions of each dimension (DF, DC, DE) and asked to choose the better question according to the specified attribute.
